eyebrow: What a compliance score actually is
code:
Compliance score =
    checks passed
    ------------------
    checks in the benchmark

e.g. CIS Benchmark:
    312 of 340 checks passed
    = 91.8%
caption: A percentage of how closely an environment matches one chosen benchmark -- not a universal grade.
